mapper.insert: insert into basket_account_security_log (member_id, event_type, event_title, old_value_masked, new_value_masked, operator_type, operator_id, client_ip, terminal_type, event_time, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{memberId}, #{eventType}, #{eventTitle}, #{oldValueMasked}, #{newValueMasked}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{clientIp}, #{terminalType}, #{eventTime}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select l.id, l.event_type as eventType, l.event_title as eventTitle, l.operator_type as operatorType, l.operator_id as operatorId, l.event_time as eventTime, l.remark, l.client_ip as clientIp, su.nick_name as operatorName from basket_account_security_log l left join sys_user su on su.user_id = l.operator_id where l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.is_delete = 0 order by l.event_time desc, l.id desc limit 50
